entries.author: observer
entries.text: Alex recommends blocking exactly two hours for Belém Tower and Jerónimos combined.

entries.author: observer
entries.text: Alex advises using a loaded Viva Viagem card with Zapping fares instead of a 24-hour pass for most travel days.

entries.author: observer
entries.text: Alex suggests booking Jerónimos and Belém Tower tickets online at least two weeks in advance for October.

entries.author: observer
entries.text: Alex believes Lisbon’s steep, winding streets will cause burnout if a traveler tries to sprint through a packed schedule.

entries.author: observer
entries.text: Alex holds that a minute-by-minute itinerary will cause travelers to miss spontaneous experiences like bakery stops and street musicians.

entries.author: observer
entries.text: Alex prefers that travelers prioritize neighborhood exploration and flexible pacing over checking off major tourist landmarks.

entries.author: observer
entries.text: Alex believes allocating half of a daily budget to food and reducing accommodation costs yields a better travel experience than a balanced split.

entries.author: observer
entries.text: Alex is confident that letting the city’s rhythm dictate the pace will make the trip more enjoyable and memorable than rigid logistics.

entries.author: observer
entries.text: Alex thinks museum tickets and castle visits are less valuable than experiencing local neighborhoods and food.
